paragraphs: Rav Natan bar Avin sat before Rav and checked most of its brain membrane; Rav told him, etc., Ḥullin 45b. Rav Ḥisda's student—I did not find it. See above, R. Natan bar Abaye, who was before Rav Ḥisda; he confused Abaye and Avin. Evidence is that he does not include R. Natan bar Abaye.
